channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Mikhail Prokhorov | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Mikhail Prokhorov from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Joseph Tsai on Mikhail Prokhorov
item.description:
“But I would say this: If you talk to all the NBA owners, they all say it makes a lot of sense to combine the ownership of a team and the arena. There’s a lot of synergy. The fans do come into the building to watch the team play, so from a business standpoint it makes a lot of sense. I hope that I would have an opportunity. But it’s up to Mikhail Prokhorov, who owns the arena, to figure out what they want to do.”

Joseph Tsai on Mikhail Prokhorov, May 9, 2019. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Sean Marks on Mikhail Prokhorov
item.description:
Marks claims the key is communication, presumably not the easiest thing with two billionaires — one based in Moscow and the other in Hong Kong.

“That’s probably one of the greatest things about [them], and a credit to Mikhail and Joe. I haven’t noticed a differing of opinions. Both collaborate,”

Sean Marks on Mikhail Prokhorov, Feb 25, 2019. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Sean Marks on Mikhail Prokhorov
item.description:
Just last week, in a discussion of the Nets future with NetsDaily, GMSean Marks noted,

“We’re going to have to be patient, Mikhail’s going to have to be patient, Joe’s going to have to be patient, but by the end of the day, we all realize, ‘let’s build the foundation.’”

Sean Marks on Mikhail Prokhorov, Feb 18, 2018. Source: NetsDaily.

item.title: Sean Marks on Mikhail Prokhorov
item.description:
Marks and Nets coach Kenny Atkinson head to ONEXIM headquarters to meet with Prokhorov, then they will scout free-agent priority Teodosic, whom one expert called the best passer in the world.

“We’re heading over to meet with Mikhail this week, so we’ll sit down with him and give him the plan and discuss things with him,”

Sean Marks on Mikhail Prokhorov, Apr 18, 2017. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Sean Marks on Mikhail Prokhorov
item.description:
“We’ve had an open dialogue really throughout the course of the season. It’s been terrific. Mikhail has been back and forth here a number of times, so now we’re going to fly over there and sit with him and meet with him.”

Sean Marks on Mikhail Prokhorov, Apr 18, 2017. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Sean Marks on Mikhail Prokhorov
item.description:
Devin Kharpertian:Sean Marks:

“It was clear to me that Mr. Prokhorov has a winning vision in mind.”

Sean Marks on Mikhail Prokhorov, Feb 19, 2016. Source: Twitter @uuords.

item.title: Adam Silver on Mikhail Prokhorov, Jason Kidd
item.description:
Tim Bontemps:Adam Silver on Mikhail Prokhorov's comments about Jason Kidd:

“I think Prokhorov has got a great sense of humor. That's what I thought.”

Adam Silver on Mikhail Prokhorov, Jason Kidd, Nov 6, 2014. Source: Twitter @TimBontemps.

item.title: Adam Silver on Mikhail Prokhorov
item.description:
Rod Boone:Adam Silver's thoughts on Mikhail Prokhorov needling Jason Kidd:

“I think Prokhorov's got a great sense of humor. That was what I thought.”

Adam Silver on Mikhail Prokhorov, Nov 6, 2014. Source: Twitter @rodboone.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Mikhail Prokhorov
item.description:
Charles F. Gardner:Kidd on Prokhorov's comments yesterday:

“I'm no longer in Brooklyn. Unfortunately they keep talking about it. I don't.”

Jason Kidd on Mikhail Prokhorov, Nov 4, 2014. Source: Twitter @cf_gardner.

item.title: Brett Yormark on Mikhail Prokhorov
item.description:
Asked by a Reuters reporter in Shanghai if the a Chinese investor in the Nets would help the team brand in China, Yormark replied...

“Mikhail Prokhorov, our principal owner, is not looking to sell the team and, for that matter, he's not necessarily looking for investors. He loves the Brooklyn Nets. He plans to be an owner for a very long period of time and is really focused on how we build the Brooklyn Nets brand as well as the Brooklyn Nets product. And that is what he is most focused on.”

Brett Yormark on Mikhail Prokhorov, Oct 11, 2014. Source: NetsDaily.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Mikhail Prokhorov
item.description:
Kidd joked after the win.

“Mikhail is the best. He has a great sense of humor, but he wants to win.”

Jason Kidd on Mikhail Prokhorov, Jan 17, 2014. Source: Wall Street Journal.

item.title: Avery Johnson on Mikhail Prokhorov, Billy King
item.description:
Avery Johnson:

“So we’re here evaluating all of these kids, we’re going through the interview process just like all of the other teams. So even though we’re at 57 now, my general manager is Billy King and Mikhail Prokhorov is the owner so you never know what they may pull off. So we’re anticipating that we could move up.”

Avery Johnson on Mikhail Prokhorov, Billy King, Jun 7, 2012. Source: ZagsBlog.com.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Mikhail Prokhorov
item.description:
“The last professional team there was the Dodgers, so I think they're going to be very excited. And then with the Russian owner (Mikhail Prokhorov), I mean, he's not short on money so I think they're going to go out and make a splash.”

Jason Kidd on Mikhail Prokhorov, May 6, 2012. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Carmelo Anthony on Mikhail Prokhorov
item.description:
“If I was to meet with that guy (Prokhorov) to be honest I really don't know what I would say.”

Carmelo Anthony on Mikhail Prokhorov, Feb 18, 2011. Source: Wall Street Journal.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Mikhail Prokhorov
item.description:
Later Cuban was talking about the expectations being much different for Avery Johnson with the Nets than it was when he coached Dallas.

“If Prokhorov shows the guts I showed to make deals, you never know,”

Mark Cuban on Mikhail Prokhorov, Dec 10, 2010. Source: Bergen Record.

item.title: Billy King on Mikhail Prokhorov
item.description:
“(Prokhorov) knows where we are. He understands where we're trying to get to, and with the rules the way they are you can't just do it overnight. Everybody reads that he says we're going to make it to the playoffs and win a championship in five years, and those to me are great goals. They should be our goals that we all want to attain.”

Billy King on Mikhail Prokhorov, Nov 20, 2010. Source: FanHouse.com.
